items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: I had one uncle on my mother's side. He played guitar, which was Eugene. Oh. That's my middle name. Maybe after he was a guitar player.

ctx.x: I'll make a note on here that this is August the 1st, 1961, and we're interviewing Mr. Christoff up at your home is 34, 25. 25. Loyal. And Ralph Collins is also here. This is Bill Russell. Do you want to give your full name, Mr. Christoff, your first name, any middle name?
Well, the middle name would be Eugene. Howell Eugene Christoff. Howell Eugene Christoff.
Howell Eugene Christoff. Do you mind telling us when you were born and what part of town?

items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: Six string guitar man, and it was all his family band, you know? New family. Old family. Old family. In which he spoke good French and all of them.

ctx.x: That was like a six string guitar?
Six string guitar man, and it was all his family band, you know? New family. Old family. Old family. In which he spoke good French and all of them. His son, French son. Yeah.

Did your grandfather ever play in any band, any professional groups, dance groups in particular were wondering about? I know it's hard to know just what they did. Yeah, that's true. But was it just a family get together sort of thing?
